name: Image-dependent affine color transformation
definition: A post-processing step performed during testing to align the model's output with the ground truth, compensating for color bias (non-zero-mean noise) that prevents perfect alignment via simple linear enhancement.
summary: Image-dependent affine color transformation aligns rendered outputs with ground truth by fitting a per-pixel or per-Gaussian affine transform via least-squares regression to compensate for color bias and exposure variations.
